## Analysis overview

This notebook produces three standalone manuscript panels:

1. the distribution of significant cancer-versus-normal proximal poly(A)-site
   usage changes for DMAi and non-DMAi sites (Figure panel A);
2. the cancer-specific APA and PRMT1/PRMT5 expression panel restricted to the
   21 cancers containing at least one significantly changed DMAi site (Figure
   panel B); and
3. the corresponding supplementary panel retaining all 26 cancers, including
   cancers without a significantly changed DMAi site.

## Methods

For each proximal poly(A) site and cancer type, usage change was defined as
mean tumour usage minus mean normal-tissue usage. Panel A displays density
estimates for sites passing the cancer-specific Benjamini--Hochberg-adjusted
threshold of P < 0.05. Panel B displays all measured DMAi and non-DMAi sites,
but its primary version is restricted to cancer types containing at least one
significantly changed DMAi site. Cancers are ordered by their median usage
change across all DMAi sites. The adjacent bars show the fraction of the 203
DMAi or 284 non-DMAi sites significant in each cancer.

The expression heatmap shows unscaled median cancer TPM for PRMT1 and PRMT5.
Spearman correlations relate median cancer TPM to the median all-site DMAi
usage change across the displayed cancer set. Two-sided asymptotic P values
were calculated using `cor.test(..., exact = FALSE)` and adjusted by the
Benjamini--Hochberg method across the ten prespecified candidate genes. The
all-cancer supplementary version repeats the complete analysis across all 26
cancer types and therefore does not condition cancer inclusion on significant
DMAi-site changes.

## Setup

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 160
)

required_packages <- c(
  "data.table", "ggplot2", "patchwork", "knitr", "scales"
)
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages)) {
  stop(
    "Install the missing packages before running this notebook: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(scales)

find_repository_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    has_git_directory <- dir.exists(file.path(candidate, ".git"))
    has_repository_directories <-
      dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "Scripts")) &&
      (
        dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "Data")) ||
          dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "data"))
      )
    if (has_git_directory || has_repository_directories) {
      return(candidate)
    }
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) {
      stop("Could not locate the PRMT-APA repository root.")
    }
    candidate <- parent
  }
}

resolve_repository_path <- function(path, must_work = FALSE) {
  expanded_path <- path.expand(path)
  is_absolute <- grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\])", expanded_path)
  resolved_path <- if (is_absolute) {
    expanded_path
  } else {
    file.path(repository_root, expanded_path)
  }
  normalizePath(resolved_path, mustWork = must_work)
}

repository_root <- find_repository_root()
site_results_file <- resolve_repository_path(
  params$site_results_file,
  must_work = TRUE
)
expression_file <- resolve_repository_path(
  params$expression_file,
  must_work = TRUE
)
figure_output_dir <- resolve_repository_path(params$figure_output_dir)
results_output_dir <- resolve_repository_path(params$results_output_dir)
dir.create(figure_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(results_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
figure_output_dir <- normalizePath(figure_output_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
results_output_dir <- normalizePath(results_output_dir, mustWork = TRUE)

apa_colours <- c(
  "DMAi" = "#FF594E",
  "non_DMAi" = "#1A85FF"
)
candidate_genes <- c(
  "PRMT1", "PRMT2", "PRMT3", "CARM1", "PRMT6",
  "PRMT5", "PRMT9", "MTAP", "PCF11", "CSTF2"
)
displayed_genes <- c("PRMT1", "PRMT5")

theme_panel <- theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#E8E8E8", linewidth = 0.35),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "#222222"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

format_probability <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x < 0.001, format.pval(x, digits = 2), sprintf("%.3f", x))
}
```

## Read and validate the source data

```{r read-data}
site_results <- fread(site_results_file)
expression <- fread(expression_file)

required_site_columns <- c(
  "tissue", "disease_type", "Identifier", "FileName",
  "mean_healthy", "mean_disease", "p_adjusted", "significant"
)
required_expression_columns <- c(
  "tissue", "disease_type", "project_id", "gene_name",
  "median_cancer_tpm"
)
missing_site_columns <- setdiff(required_site_columns, names(site_results))
missing_expression_columns <- setdiff(
  required_expression_columns,
  names(expression)
)
if (length(missing_site_columns)) {
  stop(
    "The site-results file lacks required columns: ",
    paste(missing_site_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
if (length(missing_expression_columns)) {
  stop(
    "The expression file lacks required columns: ",
    paste(missing_expression_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

cancer_key <- unique(
  expression[, .(tissue, disease_type, project_id)]
)
ambiguous_cancer_labels <- cancer_key[
  , .N,
  by = .(tissue, disease_type)
][N != 1L]
if (nrow(ambiguous_cancer_labels)) {
  stop("Tissue/disease labels do not map uniquely to TCGA projects.")
}

site_results <- merge(
  site_results,
  cancer_key,
  by = c("tissue", "disease_type"),
  all.x = TRUE
)
if (anyNA(site_results$project_id)) {
  stop("At least one APA row could not be mapped to a TCGA project.")
}
site_results[, delta_usage := mean_disease - mean_healthy]
site_results[, project_short := sub("^TCGA-", "", project_id)]
site_results[, FileName := factor(
  FileName,
  levels = c("DMAi", "non_DMAi")
)]

candidate_expression <- expression[
  gene_name %chin% candidate_genes &
    project_id %chin% unique(site_results$project_id),
  .(project_id, gene_name, median_cancer_tpm)
]
candidate_expression[, project_short := sub("^TCGA-", "", project_id)]

stopifnot(
  uniqueN(site_results$project_id) == 26L,
  uniqueN(site_results[FileName == "DMAi", Identifier]) == 203L,
  uniqueN(site_results[FileName == "non_DMAi", Identifier]) == 284L,
  nrow(candidate_expression) == 26L * length(candidate_genes),
  all(is.finite(candidate_expression$median_cancer_tpm))
)

input_inventory <- data.table(
  input = c("APA site/cancer results", "Candidate-gene expression"),
  rows = c(nrow(site_results), nrow(candidate_expression)),
  cancer_projects = c(
    uniqueN(site_results$project_id),
    uniqueN(candidate_expression$project_id)
  )
)
kable(input_inventory, caption = "Panel input data")
```

## Cancer-level summaries

```{r cancer-summaries}
total_sites <- unique(
  site_results[, .(FileName, Identifier)]
)[, .(n_total_sites = .N), by = FileName]

cancer_scores <- site_results[, .(
  all_median_delta_usage_DMAi = median(
    delta_usage[FileName == "DMAi"],
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  has_significant_DMAi_site = any(
    FileName == "DMAi" & significant,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
), by = .(project_id, project_short)]

significant_counts <- site_results[
  significant == TRUE,
  .(n_significant = .N),
  by = .(project_id, project_short, FileName)
]
proportion_data <- merge(
  CJ(
    project_id = unique(site_results$project_id),
    FileName = factor(
      c("DMAi", "non_DMAi"),
      levels = levels(site_results$FileName)
    ),
    unique = TRUE
  ),
  unique(site_results[, .(project_id, project_short)]),
  by = "project_id"
)
proportion_data <- merge(
  proportion_data,
  significant_counts,
  by = c("project_id", "project_short", "FileName"),
  all.x = TRUE
)
proportion_data[is.na(n_significant), n_significant := 0L]
proportion_data <- merge(
  proportion_data,
  total_sites,
  by = "FileName",
  all.x = TRUE
)
proportion_data[, proportion_significant := n_significant / n_total_sites]

significant_dmai_projects <- cancer_scores[
  has_significant_DMAi_site == TRUE,
  project_id
]
stopifnot(
  nrow(cancer_scores) == 26L,
  length(significant_dmai_projects) == 21L
)

kable(
  cancer_scores[order(-all_median_delta_usage_DMAi)],
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Cancer inclusion and all-site DMAi usage score"
)
```

## Panel A: significant-site usage distributions

```{r panel-a, fig.width=4.5, fig.height=4}
panel_a_data <- site_results[
  significant == TRUE & is.finite(delta_usage)
]
panel_a_data[, display_category := factor(
  as.character(FileName),
  levels = c("DMAi", "non_DMAi"),
  labels = c("DMAi-\nlengthened", "non-DMAi\nlengthened")
)]

panel_a_plot <- ggplot(
  panel_a_data,
  aes(delta_usage, fill = display_category)
) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.70, linewidth = 0.75, colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey55",
    linewidth = 0.55
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "DMAi-\nlengthened" = apa_colours[["DMAi"]],
      "non-DMAi\nlengthened" = apa_colours[["non_DMAi"]]
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.4, 0.4),
    breaks = seq(-0.4, 0.4, by = 0.2)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Tumours vs normal samples",
    x = "Change in proximal pA usage",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey55"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12.5),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.98),
    legend.justification = c(1, 1),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.55, "lines"),
    legend.background = element_blank()
  )

panel_a_plot

panel_a_file <- file.path(
  figure_output_dir,
  "tcga_apa_panel_a_significant_site_density.pdf"
)
ggsave(
  panel_a_file,
  panel_a_plot,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 4,
  units = "in",
  device = grDevices::pdf,
  useDingbats = FALSE
)
```

## Panel B plotting function

```{r panel-b-functions}
calculate_candidate_correlations <- function(project_ids, analysis_label) {
  correlation_data <- merge(
    candidate_expression[project_id %chin% project_ids],
    cancer_scores[, .(
      project_id,
      all_median_delta_usage_DMAi
    )],
    by = "project_id"
  )
  correlations <- correlation_data[, .(
    n_cancer_types = .N,
    spearman_rho = cor(
      median_cancer_tpm,
      all_median_delta_usage_DMAi,
      method = "spearman"
    ),
    p_value = suppressWarnings(cor.test(
      median_cancer_tpm,
      all_median_delta_usage_DMAi,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value)
  ), by = gene_name]
  correlations[, p_adjusted := p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")]
  correlations[, analysis := analysis_label]
  setcolorder(
    correlations,
    c(
      "analysis", "gene_name", "n_cancer_types", "spearman_rho",
      "p_value", "p_adjusted"
    )
  )
  correlations
}

make_panel_b <- function(project_ids, analysis_label) {
  cancer_order <- cancer_scores[
    project_id %chin% project_ids
  ][order(all_median_delta_usage_DMAi), project_short]

  plot_sites <- copy(site_results[project_id %chin% project_ids])
  plot_sites[, project_short := factor(
    project_short,
    levels = cancer_order
  )]
  plot_proportions <- copy(
    proportion_data[project_id %chin% project_ids]
  )
  plot_proportions[, project_short := factor(
    project_short,
    levels = cancer_order
  )]

  correlations <- calculate_candidate_correlations(
    project_ids,
    analysis_label
  )
  displayed_correlations <- correlations[
    gene_name %chin% displayed_genes
  ][match(displayed_genes, gene_name)]
  gene_labels <- setNames(
    sprintf(
      "%s\nrho=%.2f\nP=%s\nq=%s",
      displayed_correlations$gene_name,
      displayed_correlations$spearman_rho,
      format_probability(displayed_correlations$p_value),
      format_probability(displayed_correlations$p_adjusted)
    ),
    displayed_correlations$gene_name
  )

  expression_plot_data <- copy(candidate_expression[
    project_id %chin% project_ids & gene_name %chin% displayed_genes
  ])
  expression_plot_data[, project_short := factor(
    project_short,
    levels = cancer_order
  )]
  expression_plot_data[, gene_name := factor(
    gene_name,
    levels = displayed_genes
  )]

  boxplot <- ggplot(
    plot_sites,
    aes(delta_usage, project_short, fill = FileName)
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dotted",
      colour = "#555555"
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.68,
      outlier.size = 0.45,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = apa_colours,
      labels = c(DMAi = "DMAi", non_DMAi = "non-DMAi"),
      name = "APA category"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-0.22, 0.24),
      breaks = c(-0.2, -0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.2)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0(
        "Tumour – normal change in\n",
        "proximal poly(A) site usage"
      ),
      y = "TCGA project"
    ) +
    theme_panel +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13.5),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12.5),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  proportion_plot <- ggplot(
    plot_proportions,
    aes(proportion_significant, project_short, fill = FileName)
  ) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.72) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = apa_colours, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0(
        "Fraction of sites with significant\n",
        "tumour-associated APA"
      ),
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_panel +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12.5),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14.5),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  tpm_limits <- c(
    20,
    ceiling(
      max(
        candidate_expression[
          gene_name %chin% displayed_genes,
          median_cancer_tpm
        ]
      ) / 20
    ) * 20
  )
  expression_heatmap <- ggplot(
    expression_plot_data,
    aes(gene_name, project_short, fill = median_cancer_tpm)
  ) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.28) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = gene_labels) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "white",
      high = "black",
      limits = tpm_limits,
      breaks = seq(tpm_limits[1L], tpm_limits[2L], by = 20),
      oob = squish,
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 1),
      name = "Median\ncancer TPM"
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_panel +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      text = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, lineheight = 0.94),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
    )

  combined_plot <- (
    boxplot + proportion_plot + expression_heatmap
  ) +
    plot_layout(widths = c(3.2, 1.2, 1.55))

  list(
    plot = combined_plot,
    cancer_order = data.table(
      analysis = analysis_label,
      order = seq_along(cancer_order),
      project_short = cancer_order
    ),
    proportions = plot_proportions,
    correlations = correlations
  )
}
```

```{r correlation-results}
  panel_b_main$correlations,

))

  panel_correlations[gene_name %chin% displayed_genes][
    order(analysis, match(gene_name, displayed_genes))
```

## Reproducibility outputs

```{r save-results}
panel_cancer_orders <- rbindlist(list(
  panel_b_main$cancer_order,
  panel_b_all_cancers$cancer_order
))
panel_proportions <- rbindlist(list(
  copy(panel_b_main$proportions)[, analysis := panel_b_main$cancer_order$analysis[1L]],
  copy(panel_b_all_cancers$proportions)[
    , analysis := panel_b_all_cancers$cancer_order$analysis[1L]
  ]
), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

fwrite(
  panel_a_data,
  file.path(results_output_dir, "tcga_apa_panel_a_source_data.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
fwrite(
  panel_cancer_orders,
  file.path(results_output_dir, "tcga_apa_panel_b_cancer_order.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"

  panel_proportions,
  file.path(results_output_dir, "tcga_apa_panel_b_site_proportions.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
fwrite(
  panel_correlations,
  file.path(results_output_dir, "tcga_apa_panel_b_expression_correlations.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

output_inventory <- data.table(
  panel = c(
    "Figure panel A",
    "Figure panel B",
    "Supplementary panel B"
  ),
  file = c(
    panel_a_file,
    panel_b_main_file,
    panel_b_all_cancers_file
  )
)
kable(output_inventory, caption = "Generated PDF panels")
```
